title: Brushed Bronze Triple Glass Shelf, 16 X 5 In, Wall-Mounted W/ Solid Brass Hardware, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Brushed Bronze, triple glass shelf for bathroom storage with 16 x 5 inches (16-inch x 5-inch, 16in x 5in) glass dimensions and a wall mount, wall-mounted installation, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. This 3-tier wall mounted glass shelf provides organized space for toiletries while keeping counters clear. Built with thick 0.38 in beveled-edge glass and solid brass hardware; concealed screw mounting creates a clean, finished appearance. Includes the glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4 in. Rated weight capacity: 6 lb. Traditional style for classic bath accessories, heritage bathroom fixtures, and traditional bathroom hardware. Use as a bathroom glass shelf, wall mount glass shelf, or 3 tier glass shelf. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Matching Carolina available; Carolina collection by Allied Brass.
